title: VICTORY: Angel Parents THANK President Trump After Maduro's Capture - 'Justice Finally Served' | Next News Network
text:
In an emotional display at the White House, Angel Parents whose children were murdered by Venezuelan gang members delivered heartfelt thanks to President Donald Trump following the successful capture of socialist dictator Nicolás Maduro. The families, who have waited years for justice, finally saw their prayers answered under Trump's decisive leadership.
The moving scene unfolded as these brave parents, who transformed their unimaginable grief into a fight for justice, stood alongside the President who actually listened to their pleas. Unlike the previous administration that turned a deaf ear to their suffering, Trump made their cause a top priority from day one of his second term.
Social media erupted with support for the Angel Parents, with users sharing the powerful White House footage. One tweet from @Franbed3726 highlighted the emotional moment, writing "Angel Parents Comment on Maduro Capture and Thank President Trump" as the video spread across platforms, giving these families the voice they deserved all along.
"This President kept his promise to us," one Angel Parent declared through tears. "Our children's deaths will not be in vain if it means other families won't suffer what we've endured."
The capture of Maduro represents a seismic shift from the weak, America-last policies that allowed Venezuelan criminals to flood our borders unchecked. While Biden's open-border disaster imported violence and chaos, Trump's America First approach is delivering real results for grieving American families.
Justice Delayed No More
For too long, these Angel Parents watched helplessly as their children's killers received protection under sanctuary city policies while Maduro's regime exported its worst criminals to American soil. The mainstream media ignored their stories, Democrats dismissed their pain, but President Trump made their fight his own.
Patriots across the nation are celebrating this victory not just for these families, but for every American who believes in justice and the rule of law. When will the left finally admit that Trump's tough approach to international criminals actually works?
